title: Force update gate
description: Blocks the app when the installed version is below Remote Config min_app_version, with a themed update screen.

EXPO_PUBLIC_IOS_STORE_URL.description: App Store URL opened by the force-update CTA on iOS

EXPO_PUBLIC_ANDROID_STORE_URL.description: Play Store URL opened by the force-update CTA on Android

EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_UPDATE_URL.description: Optional URL opened by the force-update CTA on web (defaults to a page reload)

notes: Compares expo-application nativeApplicationVersion (or Constants.expoConfig.version) to remote-config min_app_version.
Wraps children; when outdated, shows a blocking screen instead of the app tree.
In __DEV__ on iOS/Android, Update now simulates the update (MMKV ack) instead of opening the store.
